events.title: Sphinx adds an optional comprehension quiz before Git pushes
events.title_zh: Sphinx 在 Git push 前加入可跳过的理解测验
events.summary_zh: Sphinx 0.1 用全局 Git hook 在 push 前调用另一个模型，根据已提交的 diff 提问。用户答对后 push 继续，也可以 pause、skip 或关闭检查。项目支持 Codex、Claude Code 等 provider，并明确说明这只是练习，不是安全闸门。
events.summary_en: Sphinx 0.1 installs a global Git hook that calls a separate model to quiz the user about committed diffs before a push. A correct answer resumes the push, while pause, skip and disable paths remain available. It supports Codex, Claude Code and other providers and explicitly says it is practice, not a security gate.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对 coding agent 团队来说，检查人是否理解变更是合理目标，但这个实现可绕过、会把代码发送给 reviewer provider，并缺少真实项目上的独立证据。当前不值得把它加入强制开发流程。
events.why_it_matters_en: Checking whether a human understands agent-written changes is a useful goal, but this implementation is bypassable, sends code to a reviewer provider and lacks independent evidence on real projects. It is not worth adding to a mandatory workflow yet.

technical_details.mechanism: global Git hook plus a separate read-only reviewer model
technical_details.scope: local commits and pushes; no web merges, CI required checks or deployments
technical_details.limits: skip and disable paths; model grader can be wrong; code is sent to the selected provider
technical_details.time_basis: Show HN published 2026-10-18T04:33:49Z; repository documentation verified during recall audit

technical_details_zh.机制: 全局 Git hook 加独立的只读 reviewer model
technical_details_zh.范围: 只覆盖本地 commit 与 push；不覆盖网页合并、CI required check 或部署
technical_details_zh.限制: 可以 skip 或关闭；模型判卷可能出错；代码会发给所选 provider
technical_details_zh.时间依据: Show HN 发布于 2026-10-18T04:33:49Z；召回自检期间核对仓库文档

events.next_action_zh: 不要把 0.1 当作安全闸门；等独立真实项目评测、CI 集成和不可绕过的策略边界后再评估。
events.next_action_en: Do not treat 0.1 as a security gate; revisit after independent real-project evaluation, CI integration and enforceable policy boundaries.

evidence.claim_zh: Sphinx 0.1 提供 push 前理解测验，并明确可跳过且不构成安全闸门。
evidence.claim_en: Sphinx 0.1 provides a pre-push comprehension quiz and explicitly remains bypassable and not a security gate.
